info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Bank Guarantee-spec
info.description: The Customer Bank Guarantee Management API allows businesses to facilitate the creation of bank guarantees for customers. This service streamlines the process of securing financial assurance by generating guarantees that meet specific customer requirements. Typically utilized by financial institutions and banking service providers, it supports various use cases, including loan approvals and contract assurances. By implementing this API, developers can enhance client experiences through efficient management of bank guarantees.

post.summary: Create a new bank guarantee for a specific customer.
post.description: This operation allows users to create a new bank guarantee associated with a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure all required fields are populated to process the bank guarantee creation successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new bank guarantee associated with the customer identified by CUST-100045. It must conform to the specified schema outlining the required information for the bank guarantee.

201.description: The bank guarantee has been successfully created.

CreateCustomerBankGuaranteeRequest.title: Bank Guarantee Request Body

corporateCustomerId.description: The unique identifier for the corporate customer.

facilityId.description: The unique identifier for the facility involved in the guarantee.

beneficiaryId.description: The unique identifier for the beneficiary who will receive the guarantee.

claimExpiryDate.description: The date by which claims under the guarantee must be made.
